svg.title: Frobenius-to-Normal-Form Pipeline in Stage 02 (ThetaProducts.lean)
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical diagram of the Stage 02 Frobenius-to-Normal-Form pipeline across FrobeniusCongruence.lean, Exponent.lean, and ThetaProducts.lean in three horizontal bands. Band 1 classifies the three prime-splitting regimes in K = Q(sqrt(-d)) with d = 7 mod 8: Split (chi_K(p) = +1, height 1, pi_p = p, q_p = p, rho_p = 1/(p-1), extra slope gamma_p = 0, I_p^circ = empty, no extra divisibility); Inert supersingular height 2 (chi_K(p) = -1, pi_p = p, q_p = p^2, rho_p = 1/(p^2-1), extra slope gamma_p = p/(p^2-1) = 1/p + 1/p^3 + ..., odd exponents I_p^circ = {1, 3, 5, ...}); and Ramified at p = d (chi_K(d) = 0, pi_d = sqrt(-d) with v(pi_d) = 1/2, q_d = d, rho_d = 1/(2(d-1)), extra slope gamma_d = 1/(2(d-1)), all e >= 0 in I_d^circ), unified by the prime-weight identity 2 gamma_p log p = sum_{e >= 1} Lambda(p^e)(1 - chi_K(p^e)) p^(-e). Band 2 presents the Dual Congruence Bridge for non-split primes (chi_K(p) != 1): on the left, the One-Curve Supersingular Frobenius Congruence (FrobeniusCongruence.lean and Exponent.lean) establishes theta(pi_p z)/theta(z)^(q_p) = 1 mod pi_p in O[[y]], yielding theta(varpi z) = W(z) exp(c_varpi Xi_1(z)) with v(varpi) = rho_p, c_varpi = varpi^(p+1)/p, and exact balancing valuation v(c_varpi pi_p) = 1/(p-1); on the right, the Cyclotomic Partner-Place Congruence and Resolution of the Identity (ThetaProducts.lean) pairs tau' = (-p^e) tau in Phi_s = (Z/q_1 Z)^x with tau(alpha)^(p^e) = conj(tau'(alpha)) mod pi_p, so z = sum m_j (u_j^dagger z) u_j collapses sum_j m_j (u_j^dagger z)^(p^e)(u_j^dagger z) = Gamma_e mod pi_p, erasing frame vectors u_j. Band 3 merges both mechanisms into the canonical HasNormalForm theorem New.Parameters.exists_hasNormalForm: F(varpi z) = W_tot(z) exp(c_varpi sum_{e in I_p^circ} sum_{j >= 0} lambda_{e,j} Gamma_e^(p^j)) with Gamma_e = sum_{tau,c} z_(tau,c)^(p^e) z_(-p^e tau, c), distinguishing integral clutter W_tot in O[[z]] from the sole denominator source Gamma_e (with inert unit leading coefficient lambda_{e,0} in O^x for odd e) and feeding directly into Count.lean.

g.text: 1 · PRIME-SPLITTING REGIMES IN K = ℚ(√−d) (d ≡ 7 mod 8)
Non-split primes (χK(p) ≠ 1) drive extra p-adic divisibility
Factorial gain fully canceled by ρp
2 γp log p = ∑e≥1 Λ(pe) (1 − χK(pe)) p−e (all primes p)
⇒ qp g(z) − g(πpz) ∈ πp O[[y]] (g = −log θ)
Projection g♭ & rescaling by ϖ (v(ϖ) = ρp):
θ(ϖ z) = W(z) · exp(cϖ Ξ₁(z)) (W, Ξ₁ ∈ O[[z]])
v(ϖ) = ρp · cϖ = ϖp+1/p · v(cϖ πp) = 1/(p − 1)
τ(α)pe ≡ τ′(α) (mod πp) for α ∈ OE
Resolution of identity: z = ∑j mj (uj† z) uj (mj ∈ ℕ)
Frame uj cancels — only universal couplings Γe survive
Multiply ∏j θ(uj† z)mj·H at ϖz & lift mod πp
F(ϖ z) = Wtot(z) · exp( cϖ ∑e∈Ip∘ ∑j≥0 λe,j Γepj )
Γe = ∑ τ,c z(τ,c)pe z(−pe τ, c)
Only obstruction to integrality of F(ϖ z)
Kill Γe mod πp via null frames
